title: Importlib.util.module_for_loader has been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed importlib.util.module_for_loader, so using it raises an error.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of importlib.util.module_for_loader with code that no longer depends on it.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
